label: AC-18
title: Wireless Access

children.label: a.
children.prose: Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and

children.label: b.
children.prose: Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

guidance: Wireless technologies include microwave, packet radio (ultra-high frequency or very high frequency), 802.11x, and Bluetooth. Wireless networks use authentication protocols that provide authenticator protection and mutual authentication.
